original_question: For every Connes embeddable non Gamma II1 factor N, determine whether there exists an embedding pi: N -> MU such that the relative commutant N' intersect MU is exactly C.
target_in_paper: Problem 2 in the section "Matrix ultraproducts"; the sentence immediately after it refers to this as the "ergodic Connes-embedding problem." ([ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2511.20377v2))
correct_elements: Your draft correctly captures the core mathematical content of the paper’s Problem 2: it quantifies over Connes-embeddable non-Gamma II_1 factors, asks for an embedding into the matrix ultraproduct, and seeks trivial relative commutant. Those are exactly the features that distinguish Problem 2 from the later factorial-commutant question in Problem 36. ([ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2511.20377v2))
missing_details: The paper’s ambient codomain is the tracial matrix ultraproduct associated with a fixed nonprincipal ultrafilter 𝒰 on ℕ; writing only "MU" leaves that setup implicit. The opening notation paragraph is where this is fixed. ([ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2511.20377v2))

The relative commutant should be taken for the image of the embedding, i.e. π(N)' ∩ 𝓜_𝒰, not literally N' ∩ 𝓜_𝒰. Problem 2 is phrased as an embedding question, so the image must be explicit in a stand-alone rewrite. ([ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2511.20377v2))

To be fully stand-alone, specify that N is a type II_1 factor and that the embedding is a unital trace-preserving *-embedding in the tracial von Neumann algebra setting; the paper leaves this implicit through its global notation. ([ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2511.20377v2))
Do not add a separability hypothesis: unlike Problem 36, Problem 2 does not include one. ([ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2511.20377v2))

If desired for readability, one may unpack "non-Gamma" as "without Property Gamma," but this should not broaden or change the problem. Problem 2 itself uses the shorter term "non Gamma." ([ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2511.20377v2))
refined_question: Fix a nonprincipal ultrafilter 𝒰 on ℕ, and let 𝓜_𝒰 denote the corresponding tracial matrix ultraproduct. Is it true that for every Connes-embeddable non-Gamma type II_1 factor N there exists a unital trace-preserving *-embedding π: N → 𝓜_𝒰 such that π(N)' ∩ 𝓜_𝒰 = ℂ? ([ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2511.20377v2))
justification: This paper is a numbered list of open problems rather than a theorem/conjecture paper, so the nearest official formulation is Problem 2 under "Matrix ultraproducts." That is the only place where the paper asks for all three ingredients appearing in your draft simultaneously: a Connes-embeddable non-Gamma II_1 factor, an embedding into the tracial matrix ultraproduct, and scalar relative commutant. Problem 36 is related but different: it assumes separability and asks only for factorial commutant, not trivial commutant. The notation paragraph immediately before the section is needed to make the question stand-alone because it fixes the ultrafilter convention and the matrix-ultraproduct notation used in Problem 2. ([ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2511.20377v2))
